source.paper: 面齿轮副啮合强度的简化计算_何飞

entries.name: 主方向夹角
entries.note: N2=160, Ns=27, alpha=25° 时 gamma≈-42.8°, sin(2gamma)≈-0.997

entries.name: 面齿轮主曲率 k21, k22 与 a13/a23/a33
entries.formula: k21,k22 = 0.5*(-2/(Ns*thetas*cos(alpha)) + (a13^2+a23^2)/a33 ∓ 2*a13*a23/a33*sin(2*gamma));  a13 = -tan(alpha)/thetas;  a23 = Ns*cos(alpha)/N2;  a33 = Ns^3/(2*N2^2)*(sin(alpha)*cos^2(alpha) - thetas*cos^3(alpha)) + Ns*sin^2(alpha)/(2*thetas*cos(alpha))
entries.note: 论文声明曲率推导时按'单位载荷+单位模数'归一, 最后公式再补回载荷与模数

entries.name: 多齿载荷分配系数
entries.formula: c_i = F_i/(T1/(0.5*m*N1*cos(alpha)));  双齿啮合: F1 = 2*T1/(m*N1*cos(alpha))*(dphi2-dphi1+zeta2)/(zeta1+zeta2), F2 对称

entries.name: 接触椭圆系数 A, B
全齿高接触应力解析式
entries.note: 原文印刷为 '[m^2 A / (...)]^(2/3)' 形式; 按量纲分析(m^2 应为 2A)与 ISO 赫兹点接触式复原, 属 paper-miner 重建, confidence=medium

entries.name: 齿根弯曲应力解析式与齿形系数
面齿轮副重合度
entries.formula: eps = dphi1/(2*pi/N1);  dphi1 = theta_a1 - (rs - m - d - rb1*cos(alpha))/(rb1*sin(alpha));  theta_a1 = sqrt(ra1^2-rb1^2)/rb1;  d = (rbs-rb1)/cos(alpha);  化简: eps = [theta_a1*N1*sin(alpha)*cos(alpha) - (N1-2-N1*cos^2(alpha))]/(2*pi*sin(alpha)*cos(alpha))

cross_check.note: 由 paper-miner 代入式(27) 得 1.5545; 该值与反算的 YFa*Ysa 自洽(见 HE2023-YFA-YSA-CROSSCHECK)

entries.name: 节锥面简化 A, B
entries.formula: A = (Ns+N1)*m2s^2*cos^2(alpha)/(N1*Ns*sin(alpha));  B = sqrt( 1/(N1^2*sin^2(alpha)) + 4*m2s^2/(Ns^2*tan^2(alpha)*sin^2(2*gamma)) + Z_H );  Z_H = 4*m2s/(N1*Ns*sin(alpha)*tan(alpha)*tan(2*gamma));  m2s = Ns/N2

entries.name: 接触应力简化公式
entries.note: A 用式(29) 的单位模数结果代入(数值上等价 A_actual*m), 故 m^3 出现在分母; 量纲按论文数值口径

cross_check.conclusion: 式(33) 与 b=80mm、eps≈1.55 的解释可复现论文 76.3 MPa(偏差 1%), 说明 何飞 表1 的'内径/外径'确为半径且 b=R2-R1

notes: 式(15)/(32) 的印刷形式存在下标/指数混乱, 已给出量纲一致的复原形式
图2(接触椭圆长/短轴计算系数 alpha_c, beta 与 A,B 的关系曲线)未数字化: 论文把 alpha_c, beta 做成 A-B 平面上的曲线族, 需要实现者自己生成(E(e) 第二类椭圆积分), 本数据集不提供读数

entries.note: 与 ISO 6336 一致的推荐值

entries.name: 节点区域系数 ZH
entries.formula: Z_H = sqrt(2*cos(beta_b)*cos(alpha_t')/(cos^2(alpha_t)*sin(alpha_t')));  beta_b = arctan(tan(beta)*cos(alpha_t));  alpha_t = arctan(tan(alpha_n)/cos(beta));  inv(alpha_t') = inv(alpha_t) + 2*(x1+x2)*tan(alpha_n)/(z1+z2)

verified.conclusion: 论文印刷的简写系数 0.175 / 0.35 正确

entries.name: 载荷作用角/当量齿轮几何
entries.formula: alpha_Fen = alpha_en - gamma_e;  alpha_en = arccos(d_bn/d_en);  d_bn = d_n*cos(alpha_n);  d_n = d/cos(beta)... ; d_an = d_a + d - d_en ...; eps_an = eps_a/cos^2(beta_b); gamma_e = (pi/2 + 2*x_n*tan(alpha_n))/z_vn + inv(alpha_n) - inv(alpha_en); z_v = z/(cos(beta_b)*cos^2(beta))
entries.note: 该组公式在 OCR 中严重散乱, 仅记录结构与符号; 实现时应以 ISO 6336-3 / HB/Z84.3 原文为准

entries.name: 危险截面齿厚与弯曲力臂
entries.formula: S_Fn = 2*[ (d_n/2 - H1)*sin(phi) - (d_n/2*phi - G)*cos(phi) - rho_a0*cos(pi/6) ];  h_Fe = d_bn/(2*cos(alpha_Fen)) - [ (d_n/2 - H1)*cos(phi) + (d_n/2*phi - G)*sin(phi) - rho_a0*sin(pi/6) ]
entries.symbols: H1 刀具齿顶圆角圆心至加工节线距离; G 圆心到齿槽中心线距离; rho_a0 刀具齿顶圆半径; phi 与30°切线角对应的滚动角
